# wasm/ios/dist

Pre-built WASM artifact for `ruvector-ios-wasm`.

## Files

- `recommendation.wasm` (~50 KB) - Compiled WASM module (size-optimized release build) for the recommendation engine demo.

## How to regenerate

```bash
cd /home/user/ruvector/examples/wasm/ios
bash scripts/build.sh
```

- Larger Swift-bundled copy: `../swift/Resources/recommendation.wasm`.
